rootCause: Moving the root npm manifest into JSON and staging the npm workspace exposed that @novaoryn/ide-extension did not explicitly declare @types/react. The React runtime was installed transitively through Theia, but TypeScript had no React/JSX declarations, causing TS7016/TS7026 cascades across all TSX widgets.
fixes: Declare @types/react ^18.3.0 as an explicit devDependency of @novaoryn/ide-extension.
Verify @types/react is actually installed in the extension workspace before TypeScript compilation.
Retain npm execution from .toolchain/NpmWorkspace so C:\NovaOrynIDE remains free of root JSON files.
Bump active IDE/generator/configurator release metadata to 0.11.6 while preserving historical compatibility references.

validation.windowsNpmInstallAndFullTheiaBuild: must run via Build-NovaOrynIDE.bat on Windows
